references.text: Abimelek called for Abraham and said: "What have you done to us?" – almost identical wording and situation where a ruler confronts Abraham for having hidden that Sarah is his wife.
Abimelek called for Isaac and said: "What is this you have done to us?" – similar situation where Isaac misrepresents his relationship with Rebekah to a king.
"He did not allow anyone to oppress them; he rebuked kings on their behalf" – this verse refers to God's protection of the patriarchs, including the incident with Pharaoh and Abraham.
Abraham asked Sarah to say she was his sister – this is the direct background for Pharaoh's accusation: "Why did you not tell me that she is your wife?"
Parallel event where a king confronts Abraham about the lie concerning his wife, underscoring a recurring pattern of testing and God's protection.
